mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_data.knowledge_space WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, name, description, status, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.knowledge_space WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, name, description, status, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.knowledge_space WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, name, description, status, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM knowledge_data.knowledge_space WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DELETED' AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
